name: Sophos Email
summary: Sophos Email is managed from Sophos Central and covers phishing, malware and impersonation with VIP, brand and general impersonation checks. Sophos publishes no prices and sends buyers to a Get pricing form, so budget by asking for a written quote.

facts.text: Sophos documents three impersonation checks: VIP impersonation, brand impersonation and general impersonation. Quarantine is one of the available actions, where the message is held in quarantine.

The anti-malware policy scans messages and attachments with heuristic checks and Intelix sandbox analysis, and can quarantine known malware, unscannable messages and Intelix Malicious and Suspicious messages.
Admins can search messages that Microsoft 365 quarantined and release or delete them from the M365 quarantine tab in Sophos Central.
The Email Security policy has sections for authentication checks, anti-malware, anti-spam, impersonation protection, URL and QR code protection, image analysis and end user quarantine.
